scope: Spectral graph theory and spectral gaps only
task_kind: Evidence-backed research direction selection with one bounded obstruction check
decision: Choose a structural graph programme grounded in the current proofs and current primary literature
success_evidence: Separate proof status, novelty, importance and formalization
Compare no more than three graph directions by exact unresolved inference
Check whether a single base-edge phase can improve the small-excess tail exponent in K4 lifts
Save a precise next mathematical question and a formalization route

participants.proof_inventory: Read-only evidence and formalization audit, then exact-revision review if assigned
participants.phase_frontier: Phase obstruction proof in owned phase-obstruction directory

execution: Interactive coordination with bounded delegated tasks
resource_limits: No unattended processes, no external teammate messages, no historical runner launches, no paid services
checkpoint: Freeze the phase obstruction before separate review
stopping_condition: Return a supported strategic assessment, reviewed obstruction or exact gap, and one next action. Do not start a broad theorem campaign.
prior_exposure: All participants inherited current chat context. Separate review means a separately reconstructed argument, not access isolation.
